description: Decode bounded BitBench five11 packets and sum their 11-bit channel values.

input.packet_encoding: 5-bit channel count followed by that many unsigned 11-bit channel values, with pad bits to the next byte boundary
input.bit_order: most-significant bit first within each byte
input.trailing_input_behavior: bytes after the final padded packet are ignored

output.meaning: sum of all decoded unsigned 11-bit channel values

pinned_source.dataset_note: The launcher fixture is 13,523 bytes, declares 451 packets, and yields 2,003,051. Those records consume 6,392 bytes; the source ignores the remaining bytes. The bounded ports retain the source’s 10,000 repeated decode-and-sum passes.
